title: Post-hoc localization of Object Index alias, true-owner bilinear support and curvature-stencil support
question: Within the immutable D12.9-H1 radius-2 domains, how much loss and hidden aliasing comes from true analytic-owner disagreement in the four bilinear taps, from the additional 4x4 curvature stencil, and from Q30 rejection after true-owner support is available?
decisionRole: post-hoc failure localization on already observed H1 data; it cannot validate a new candidate, alter H1, choose a production threshold or count as a fresh holdout

requirements: The analyzer path and output root do not exist at preregistration.
No H1 byte may be changed, rewritten or copied into a replacement formal root.
No new Blender render, model call, network call or subjective review is permitted.
Every classification, gate, attack family and verdict label is frozen before analyzer output.
Any later intervention derived from this analysis requires a new identity and a fresh holdout.

independentOwnerOracle.implementation: scalar Python math only; imports of bpy, bpy_extras, mathutils and every D12.9 consumer/analyzer are forbidden
independentOwnerOracle.camera: Blender camera looks along local -Z; use the frozen 47 mm horizontal-fit pinhole projection
independentOwnerOracle.surfaceSelection: at frame 0 or frame 1, cast the declared pixel-center ray through every bounded analytic plane and choose the nearest positive camera-depth hit
independentOwnerOracle.token: the 1-based index of the selected analytic owner in the frozen fixture owners array; unlike Object Index, this token remains different when two owners share passIndex
independentOwnerOracle.currentIdentityCheck: the independently recomputed frame-1 token mask must equal the frozen analyzer-emitted analytic-owner.u8 payload byte-for-byte
independentOwnerOracle.previousIdentity: compute a full frame-0 token mask independently; do not infer it from previous Object Index

classificationContract.bilinearTapSet: the four floor(q) taps in y0x0,y0x1,y1x0,y1x1 order
classificationContract.trueOwnerBilinearCompatible: all four previous oracle tokens equal the current oracle token and are nonzero
classificationContract.trueOwnerCurvatureCompatible: trueOwnerBilinearCompatible and all 16 curvature-stencil tokens equal the current oracle token
classificationContract.objectIndexBilinearAlias: frozen Object Index structural validity or support admits the pixel while trueOwnerBilinearCompatible is false
classificationContract.objectIndexCurvatureAlias: frozen support-eligible.u8 is true while trueOwnerCurvatureCompatible is false
classificationContract.oneSidedStencilOpportunity: TRUE_OWNER_EXTRA_STENCIL_MISMATCH; four interpolation taps are owner-correct, but symmetric curvature support crosses an owner boundary
classificationContract.acceptedOutsideTrueOwnerBilinear: accepted.u8 while trueOwnerBilinearCompatible is false; report as a safety-critical localization, never relabel H1

perCell: support-rejected and risk-rejected counts inside each true-owner class
accepted count and fraction against radius2
accepted count and fraction against trueOwnerBilinearCompatible
accepted count and fraction against trueOwnerFullStencil
measurements.perOwner: repeat the counts for every current analytic owner with a non-empty radius2 domain
measurements.repeatIdentity: all oracle token masks and derived classification payloads must be byte-identical between repeat 1 and repeat 2
measurements.aggregation: repeat 1 is descriptive primary; repeat 2 is identity control only

families: tamper a parent SHA, internal hash, fixture, repeat or formal verdict
flip pixel-center, Y origin, Euler order, frame number or nearest-surface selection
replace analytic owner token with Object Index
swap current and previous token masks or owner indices
change q sign, tap order, floor rule or 4x4 extent
break the three-way partition, repeat identity or per-owner accounting
hide acceptedOutsideTrueOwnerBilinear or merge it into ordinary risk rejection
introduce a new threshold, supported candidate, Blender render, model call or network call

decision.localizedWhen: All identities, oracle checks, partitions, repeats, same-index alias exposure, moving one-sided opportunity, operation counts and attacks pass.
decision.noPromotion: Neither verdict supports a reconstruction candidate or changes D12.9-H1.

nonClaims: D12.10-D1 is post-hoc on H1 and is not a holdout.
Analytic owner tokens are compiler-known ground truth for these synthetic planar scenes, not yet a validated production AOV.
The analysis does not prove Material Index, Cryptomatte or a custom AOV is the correct transport mechanism.
One-sided stencil opportunity is a localization count, not evidence that a one-sided estimator is safe.
No coverage denominator is changed and no H1 failure is relabeled.
